translations.web: Call Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will show you what you shall do. You shall anoint to me him whom I name to you.”
translations.bsb: Then invite Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will show you what you are to do. You are to anoint for Me the one I indicate.”
translations.kjv: And call Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will shew thee what thou shalt do: and thou shalt anoint unto me him whom I name unto thee.
translations.asv: And call Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will show thee what thou shalt do: and thou shalt anoint unto me him whom I name unto thee.
